name: Ancient Moonstone Seal
summary: In Bashal'Aran, the Ancient Moonstone Seal holds Asterion captive among the ruins. The Highborne forged it long before the Sundering, binding his spirit with arcane magic.

sections.title: A Prison of Highborne Sorcery
sections.body: Athrikus Narassin, Asterion's former master, forged the Ancient Moonstone Seal to bind his soul to Bashal'Aran's pillars. The Highborne sorcerer made it an unbreakable anchor while the Well of Eternity still stood and Queen Azshara reigned. More than ten millennia later, Asterion remains a spirit bound by its magic. No strength or spell he commands can break the ward.

sections.title: Destruction in Ameth'Aran
sections.body: After the Great Sundering, the Deth'ryll satyrs took the seal into Darkshore's surrounding wilderness. Highborne enchanted stone yields to no ordinary force. To destroy the relic, it must meet the ancient blue flame still burning in Ameth'Aran's twin ruins to the south. That fire shatters Athrikus's binding ward and frees Asterion's spirit to enter the mortal realm.

faq.q: What is the Ancient Moonstone Seal?
faq.answer: Athrikus Narassin, a Highborne sorcerer, crafted the Ancient Moonstone Seal to bind Asterion's ghost to his shrine in Bashal'Aran.

faq.q: Who possesses the seal before it is recovered?
faq.answer: Before anyone recovers it, a Deth'ryll satyr in the ruins around Bashal'Aran holds the seal. Its presence lets the satyr command lesser grell minions.

faq.q: How can the seal be destroyed?
aliases: where do i destroy the seal
faq.answer: Ordinary weapons and present-day magic cannot harm the seal. It must be cast into the ancient flame still burning in Ameth'Aran's twin ruins to the south.

faq.q: What happens when the seal is destroyed?
aliases: what does breaking the seal do
faq.answer: The flame in Ameth'Aran destroys the seal and breaks the enchantments binding Asterion. After thousands of years in captivity, his spirit is free to roam the world.

angles.text: As a Night Elf, you can see in the seal the Highborne's arcane power and their cruel enslavement practices before the Great Sundering.
As a mage, you can see how ancient elven abjuration magic held its binding field for more than ten thousand years in the moonstone.
